title: Extend Memes v3 research to Solana and cross-chain narrative selection
objective: Implement the smallest bounded extension of the existing Memes v3 Alpha Research Workstream that adds deterministic Solana collection and cross-chain narrative comparison. Preserve the base workstream and its frozen candidate. Add exact mint verification, creator/authority metadata, buyer acceleration, sniper/bundler/funder cluster features, paid-boost separation and fixed-horizon chain comparison without creating a parallel engine or any trade authority.

evidence.summary: Owner-approved addendum defines Solana as a first-class lane and cross-chain narrative-selection methodology while preserving existing authority boundaries.
Restricted research lead records user observation, source-identity caveat, current Solana cases and positive/negative controls.
Existing base implementation candidate remains authoritative and must not be invalidated or rewritten by this extension.

reproduction: On current main, the owner-approved base Memes v3 workstream and Codex candidate explicitly target Robinhood Chain and Ethereum for the initial deterministic polling requirement. There is no first-class Solana collector/classifier or cross-chain narrative comparison contract in the base implementation. Verify this against the base operational contract and candidate, then implement Solana only as a bounded extension that reuses existing Memes Alpha event/outcome schemas and orchestration.

positive: A Solana mint fixture is verified as Solana identity before any event row is accepted.

Pump.fun/PumpSwap or Raydium fixture produces deterministic pool, liquidity, buyer and authority metadata using the existing research event contract or a backwards-compatible extension owned by Memes Alpha.
A distributed-funder fixture with low top-10 concentration but linked fresh-wallet clusters is flagged for cluster risk rather than classified as clean distribution.
A paid DexScreener boost is stored separately from organic social/on-chain propagation and never counts as independent alpha evidence.
Two tokens expressing the same frozen narrative on different chains can be compared at matched 5m/15m/1h/6h/24h horizons without using later outcomes to alter discovery-time features.
A Solana no-change run performs a deterministic no-op and makes zero unnecessary model calls.
Private exact watchlist values remain in the restricted plane while public health remains value-free.
negative: A ticker/name match without exact mint verification cannot create a cross-chain sibling relationship.
Low top-10 concentration alone cannot classify distribution as organic when bundle/funder evidence is missing or adverse.
Paid boost, Telegram call or KOL post alone cannot promote a token or wallet to qualified alpha.
Unknown Solana wallet-cluster evidence remains UNKNOWN and is not inferred from holder counts.
The extension must not rewrite or invalidate the frozen base Memes v3 Codex candidate.
The extension must fail if it emits BUY, SELL, position size, portfolio action, canonical promotion, threshold mutation or model-weight changes.
No implementation may change API hard-stop, lane-cap or reserve values, authorize paid data, or self-merge.
